description: Per-language validation command configuration, produced by set_env.detect_tooling and persisted to .agent/env.json. The root is a hybrid object: the optional top-level `interactive_prompt` is a string, while every other key is a language extension (py, js, rs, etc.) mapping to a command bundle.

interactive_prompt.description: Exact prompt string the program displays when waiting for user input. Omit or empty when the project has no interactive mode.

LanguageCommands.description: Command bundle for a single language extension. Commands are argv lists. `{file}` and `{module}` placeholders are substituted at invocation time.

install_command.description: Install dependencies for this language (e.g. pip install -e . or npm install). Optional.

syntax.description: Syntax / compile check. Required for every extension.

import.description: Verify the module can be imported/loaded. Optional.

cross_import.description: Verify cross-file imports resolve against project files. Optional.

lint.description: Lint / code-quality check, preferably auto-fixing. Optional.
